fixture_kind: synthetic CPU reference inputs; not recorded model responses
purpose: Study a coding-agent harness with planning, tools, checkpoints and approval.
mechanism: The harness gives a model repository tools and a test runner; the bundled bank-account task is deliberately buggy learning material.
experiment: Run the account tests before and after an agent patch and inspect whether the agent weakens tests to claim success.
production: Run the harness in an ephemeral container without host credentials, limit write paths and retain patch/test evidence for review.
